title.en: Choosing an experience for how it feels
title.zh: 为体验本身选择一段时间

paragraphs.en: Atmosphere Seeker concerns music, a walk, a small evening ritual or an easy gathering chosen for mood and enjoyment. It is not a measure of mood, extraversion, escapism or substance use. The four descriptions do not ask about drinking or imply that alcohol is needed.
paragraphs.zh: “氛围体验者”关注为了气氛与享受选择音乐、散步、晚间小仪式或轻松聚会。不测心情、外向、逃避或物质使用。四条描述不询问饮酒，也不暗示需要酒精。

paragraphs.en: An experience may be pleasant without producing a useful output. You may enjoy one kind of atmosphere and dislike another. A count cannot establish what relaxes you, whether a practice improves health or why a particular setting appeals to you.
paragraphs.zh: 体验可以没有实用产出，却仍让人愉快。喜欢一种氛围、讨厌另一种，也可以并存。次数不能确定什么使你放松、做法是否改善健康或某种环境为何吸引你。

title.en: A different ending to an ordinary day
title.zh: 给普通一天换一种结尾

paragraphs.en: After finishing an ordinary day, you choose a short familiar walk with music instead of adding another task. The appeal may be the evening light or the feeling of transition. It does not have to become a routine, an achievement or a public story.
paragraphs.zh: 普通一天结束后，你选一段熟悉短路配音乐，而不是再加一项任务。吸引力可能是傍晚光线，也可能是切换的感觉。不必把它变成习惯、成就或公开故事。

paragraphs.en: A walk is not available or appropriate in every setting. Quiet at home, a conversation or no extra activity may suit you better. The guide offers an example of preference, not a recommendation that everyone use the same activity to manage a difficult day.
paragraphs.zh: 并非所有环境都适合散步。居家安静、交谈或不加活动，也可能更适合。指南给的是偏好例子，不建议所有人用相同活动处理困难一天。

title.en: Pleasure does not need a productivity excuse
title.zh: 乐趣不必附上效率理由

paragraphs.en: Choosing an enjoyable setting can make time feel worth having on its own terms. Whether the experience was actually enjoyable is yours to observe. The count cannot prove recovery, social ease or an ability to create a welcoming environment for others.
paragraphs.zh: 选择喜欢的环境，可以让这段时间按自身意义成立。是否真享受，需要自己观察。次数不能证明恢复、社交自在或为别人创造舒适环境的能力。

paragraphs.en: Trying to make every evening feel special can also become another demand. Notice the preparation, cost and energy involved, and whether you still want it. You can keep a ritual simple, skip it or change your mind without losing a supposed type.
paragraphs.zh: 每晚都必须特别，也可能变成新要求。可以看准备、花费与精力，以及是否仍想要。仪式可以简化、跳过或临时改变，不会因此失去某种类型。

title.en: Atmosphere, quiet and play
title.zh: 氛围、安静与玩乐

paragraphs.en: Quiet Observer emphasizes leaving some comparisons or visible achievement aside. Atmosphere Seeker emphasizes the quality of a chosen experience, which may be lively or quiet. A person may enjoy a busy concert without pursuing status or choose silence without a special ritual.
paragraphs.zh: “静观者”偏向放下一些比较或可见成就；本主题偏向选中体验的质感，可以热闹，也可以安静。可以享受热闹演出却不追求地位，也可以选择没有仪式的安静。

paragraphs.en: Lightener concerns finding a playful element in an event. An atmosphere can be serious, thoughtful or calm without humor. Neither theme establishes happiness, popularity or how other people should feel in your company.
paragraphs.zh: “轻松找乐者”关注发现好玩元素；氛围可以严肃、沉思或平静，不必幽默。两项都不确定幸福、受欢迎程度或别人与你相处应该怎样感受。

title.en: A small choice with no required outcome
title.zh: 不规定效果的小选择

paragraphs.en: If you want, choose one safe, low-cost sensory detail for a short ordinary break: a familiar song or a comfortable light, for example. Notice whether you like it without requiring it to improve your mood. You can stop or choose nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 如果愿意，给一段普通短休息选一个安全、无需额外花费的感官细节，例如熟悉歌曲或舒服灯光。只观察喜不喜欢，不要求必须改善心情。可以停止或什么都不选。

paragraphs.en: When sharing an experience, ask whether the other person welcomes the music, lighting or conversation. Your preference is not everyone’s comfort. No gathering, purchase, alcohol or disclosure is needed to complete this optional reflection.
paragraphs.zh: 共享体验时，问对方是否欢迎音乐、灯光或交谈。自己的偏好不代表所有人的舒服程度。可选反思不需要聚会、消费、酒精或披露。

title.en: A substance-free repair of the source theme
title.zh: 来源主题的无酒精修订

paragraphs.en: DRUNK remains an owned provenance code only. This Web edition explicitly develops an atmosphere-and-experience theme without adopting a drinking inference. Four literal descriptions yield zero to four selections against fixed opponents, not a norm, health reading or complete ordering of all themes.
paragraphs.zh: DRUNK仅保留为自有溯源代码。Web版明确发展氛围与体验主题，不采纳饮酒推断。四条字面描述在固定对象比较中产生零到四次，不是常模、健康读数或全部主题完整排序。

paragraphs.en: Every full guide is free before answering, and all highest ties remain visible. Public links contain no personal habits, responses or counts. The game cannot explain persistent changes in mood, energy or substance use; those concerns need their own appropriate attention.
paragraphs.zh: 作答前可免费读全部指南，保留全部最高并列。公开链接不含个人习惯、答案或次数。游戏不能解释持续的心情、精力或物质使用变化；这些问题需要各自合适的关注。

title.en: Low-Battery Rebuilder: Full SBTI Theme Guide
title.zh: 低电量整备者：SBTI完整主题读法

summary.en: Low-Battery Rebuilder concerns reducing a load when energy feels low, taking a small reset after discouragement and separating a difficult moment from the next manageable action. It does not measure energy, functioning, depression, resilience or your value as a person.
summary.zh: “低电量整备者”关注精力偏低时减负、泄气后稍作调整，以及把困难时刻与下一件可做事情分开。不测精力、功能、抑郁、韧性或个人价值。

scoreReading.en: A raw count of choices: 0–4 across this theme’s four scheduled comparisons. It is not a measured trait, percentile or complete ranking of all themes.
scoreReading.zh: 原始选择次数：本主题四次固定比较中选了0—4次。不是测得的特质、百分位或所有主题的完整排名。

title.en: Low-Battery Rebuilder | SBTI 50-Choice Theme Guide
title.zh: 低电量整备者｜SBTI费马50组修订版指南

description.en: Read the complete Low-Battery Rebuilder theme: concrete examples, tradeoffs, neighboring themes and an optional reflection. Free; no personality diagnosis.
description.zh: 免费完整阅读“低电量整备者”：具体场景、取舍、相近主题区别与可选观察。费马50组趣味修订版，不作人格或健康诊断。

title.en: Reducing the load before a small return
title.zh: 先减负担，再回到一小步

paragraphs.en: Low-Battery Rebuilder concerns reducing a load when energy feels low, taking a small reset after discouragement and separating a difficult moment from the next manageable action. It does not measure energy, functioning, depression, resilience or your value as a person.
paragraphs.zh: “低电量整备者”关注精力偏低时减负、泄气后稍作调整，以及把困难时刻与下一件可做事情分开。不测精力、功能、抑郁、韧性或个人价值。

paragraphs.en: The descriptions may fit an occasional demanding day or may not fit at all. The count cannot explain why you feel depleted or distinguish temporary strain from a persistent problem. Recognizing the theme is neither a diagnosis nor evidence of weakness.
paragraphs.zh: 描述可能适合偶尔忙累的一天，也可能完全不适合。次数不能解释消耗原因，也不能区分短暂压力与持续问题。认得主题不是诊断，更不是软弱证据。

title.en: A smaller task after an unhelpful setback
title.zh: 受挫后先换一件小事

paragraphs.en: A draft comes back with unexpected changes and you feel unable to face the whole revision. You set it aside briefly, check what is actually required and choose one manageable paragraph later. That is an example of adjusting the next step, not proof that the feeling has been resolved.
paragraphs.zh: 初稿退回，改动比预想多，你暂时不想面对全部修订。先放一会儿，核对真正要求，之后选一段能处理的。例子描述下一步怎样调整，不证明感受已经解决。

paragraphs.en: You might instead need more time, a clearer brief, practical support or permission not to continue. A small action is not always the right response. The guide never makes productivity a condition for deserving rest or support.
paragraphs.zh: 也可能需要更多时间、更清楚的要求、实际支持，或不继续的余地。小行动并非总是正确回应。指南从不把有产出当成值得休息或支持的条件。

title.en: A reset is an option, not a recovery promise
title.zh: 调整是选项，不是恢复保证

paragraphs.en: Reducing demands may make a next step easier to see in an ordinary situation. Whether it helps is something to observe, not a result promised by the game. A slower pace can be a practical adjustment rather than a judgment about ability.
paragraphs.zh: 普通情境中，降低要求可能让下一步更清楚；是否有用需观察，游戏不保证。放慢可以是实际调整，不是能力评价。

paragraphs.en: If even a small step feels like another demand, you may stop. Repeated difficulty or a large change from your usual state deserves attention beyond a playful reading. The label cannot establish a cause or decide what kind of help is appropriate.
paragraphs.zh: 如果小步骤也像另一项要求，可以停下。反复困难或与平时很大差异，值得在趣味读法之外认真关注。标签不能确定原因，也不能决定哪种帮助合适。

title.en: Pausing, self-criticism and a next step
title.zh: 暂停、苛责与下一步

paragraphs.en: Pause Taker concerns adding a gap between demands. Low-Battery Rebuilder specifically concerns a response to low energy or discouragement and what load to reduce. A person may enjoy routine pauses without recognizing the discouragement descriptions.
paragraphs.zh: “休眠者”偏向在要求之间加间歇；本主题特别关注低精力或泄气后的回应，以及怎样减负。喜欢日常暂停，也可以不认得泄气描述。

paragraphs.en: Self-Critic concerns a harsh assessment of your performance. You can feel low on energy without criticizing yourself, or criticize a detail while feeling energetic. Neither count measures symptoms or establishes how you should feel about a difficult day.
paragraphs.zh: “自我苛责者”关注严厉评自己的表现。精力低时可以不苛责；精力足时也可能苛责细节。次数都不测症状，也不规定困难一天应该有什么感受。

title.en: A next step can also be asking for room
title.zh: 下一步也可以是争取余地

paragraphs.en: If useful, name one demand you can postpone or renegotiate, rather than adding a new improvement goal. A possible next step is asking for clearer priorities or telling someone that you need more time. Keep the change limited to what is genuinely within your control.
paragraphs.zh: 若合适，可以指出一项能延后或重谈的要求，而不是再加改善目标。下一步也可以是问清优先次序，或告诉别人需要更多时间。只调整真正属于自己能决定的部分。

paragraphs.en: You can leave the exercise here without a task. If low energy or discouragement persists, affects daily life or concerns you, consider an appropriate qualified professional or someone you trust. No score is required to seek support, and this game is not a care plan.
paragraphs.zh: 也可以读到这里，不做任务。若低精力或泄气持续、影响生活或让你担心，可以考虑合适专业人士或信任的人。寻求支持不需要达到某次数，游戏也不是照护计划。

title.en: IMFW carries no judgment of worth
title.zh: IMFW不评价个人价值

paragraphs.en: IMFW remains the owned source identifier, while this repair removes a derogatory interpretation of ability or worth. Four new concrete descriptions each appear once, twice as A and twice as B overall. The raw count is not a symptom score, norm or complete ranking of twenty-five themes.
paragraphs.zh: IMFW仅保留为自有来源标识，修订移除对能力或价值的贬低解读。四条具体新描述各出现一次，整体A、B各两次。原始次数不是症状分、常模或二十五主题的完整排名。

paragraphs.en: All complete guides are public and free, including every highest tie and themes you did not select. Public links contain no answers or counts. Your value and your right to rest do not depend on this game, the result or how much you accomplish afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 包括最高并列与未选主题，全部完整指南公开免费。公开链接没有个人答案或次数。个人价值与休息权利，不取决于游戏、结果或之后完成多少事情。

title.en: Which SBTI edition is this?
title.zh: 这是哪个SBTI版本？

paragraphs.en: This is FermatMind’s own fifty-choice Web repair of twenty-five themes from its Mini program. The questions and complete bilingual readings are newly written for this edition. It is not the thirty-one-question Mini bank, a reproduction of another site’s twenty-seven-type version, or a standardized personality assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 这是费马以自有小程序二十五个主题为脉络撰写的五十组成对选择Web修订版，题目与完整双语读法均为本版新写。它不是小程序三十一题原题本，也不复现其他网站的二十七型版，不是标准人格测评。

paragraphs.en: The earlier theme labels provide editorial lineage. This edition does not use its fifteen-coordinate model, hidden branches, result-distribution hash or claims about rarity. Safe display names describe ordinary experiences; a selection cannot establish ability, personal worth, family history, substance use or a diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 旧主题标签只提供编辑来源脉络。本版不使用原十五坐标模型、隐藏分支、结果分配hash或稀有程度说法。安全展示名称描述普通体验，选择不能确定能力、个人价值、家庭经历、物质使用或诊断。

title.en: Fifty fixed comparisons, with room to stop
title.zh: 五十组固定比较，可以随时停止

paragraphs.en: Use the past month as a reference. In each pair, choose the description that feels relatively closer, rather than the one you think is better. The statements can describe different situations and are not logical opposites. If neither feels suitable, you can exit and read any guide without answering.
paragraphs.zh: 以过去一个月为参照，每组选择相对更像自己的描述，不选认为更好的那条。陈述可能涉及不同情境，不是逻辑反义项。两条都不适合时，可以退出，不作答直接读任一指南。

paragraphs.en: All fifty choices are required for the final count. There is no imputation, timer, random question order or random assignment. You can go back to change a choice before submitting. The result is specific to these comparisons and the period you considered.
paragraphs.zh: 最终次数要求五十组全部选择，不填补、不计时、不随机题序或分配结果。提交前可以返回修改。结果只属于这些比较及所参考的时间。

title.en: One choice adds one, with all ties retained
title.zh: 选一次记一次，保留全部并列

paragraphs.en: Each theme has four distinct descriptions, appearing twice as option A and twice as B against four other themes. Selecting a description adds one to its theme. Every theme therefore has a raw count from zero to four, and the twenty-five counts add up to fifty.
paragraphs.zh: 每个主题有四条不同描述，A、B各出现两次，与另外四个主题比较。选择某条给对应主题加一次。因此每主题原始次数为零到四，二十五主题次数总和为五十。

paragraphs.en: Every theme tied at the largest raw count is shown; none is picked by a hash or hidden tie-break. All-A and all-B responses each give every theme two selections, so a twenty-five-way tie is possible and valid. A count of four means choosing all four offered descriptions, not being fully or certainly that personality.
paragraphs.zh: 原始次数最大的所有主题都展示，不用hash或隐藏规则打破并列。全A与全B都会使每主题各两次，二十五方并列允许且有效。四次表示四条所给描述都选了，不表示百分之百或确定属于该人格。

title.en: Equal appearances do not validate a personality test
title.zh: 出现均等不等于人格测量有效

paragraphs.en: Themes face different opponents, not all twenty-four other themes. Equal appearances and balanced option positions do not remove wording, context or opponent effects. These counts cannot provide a complete ordering of twenty-five traits, population norms, percentiles, clinical cutoffs or a fixed identity.
paragraphs.zh: 每主题面对的对象不同，没有与另外二十四主题全部比较。出现次数与位置均衡，不能消除措辞、情境和对手影响。次数不能提供二十五特质完整排序、人口常模、百分位、临床阈值或固定身份。

paragraphs.en: Reliability, validity and English–Chinese measurement equivalence have not been established. English and Chinese were written for this Web edition; changing the language or comparing with an older SBTI version is not an equivalent repeat measurement. Use the game as an invitation to consider examples, not for selection or consequential decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 本版尚未建立信度、效度或英中文测量等值。中英文均为Web本版撰写，换语言或与旧SBTI版本比较，不是等值复测。游戏用于引出具体例子的思考，不用于选拔或重大决定。

title.en: Private choices, public explanations
title.zh: 私人选择，公开解释

paragraphs.en: Answers and counts remain in current-page memory, without automatic drafts, answer uploads or a personal-result URL. Refreshing, leaving, changing language, clearing or retaking removes them. Copy buttons share only public explanation links with no choices, counts, private text or internal result identifier.
paragraphs.zh: 答案与次数仅保留当前页面内存，不自动存草稿、不上传答案、不生成个人结果网址。刷新、离开、换语、清除或重测会移除。复制按钮只分享公开解释链接，没有选择、次数、私人文字或内部结果标识。

paragraphs.en: Optional activity measurement requires both your explicit choice on this page and the site analytics consent. It records only coarse activity actions, never the answers, counts or selected theme. Every full guide remains free before answering; no account, payment, sharing or further test is required.
paragraphs.zh: 可选活动统计同时需要本页明确选择与网站分析同意，仅记录粗略活动动作，不含答案、次数或所选主题。作答前可免费读全部完整指南，无需账户、付费、分享或再做测评。

question.en: Is this the viral thirty-one-question SBTI?
question.zh: 这是流行的三十一题SBTI吗？

answer.en: No. This is the clearly labeled FermatMind fifty-choice repair using twenty-five owned source themes and a new bank. It does not reproduce another site’s questions, hidden types or fifteen-dimension output.
answer.zh: 不是。本页明确采用费马五十组修订版：二十五个自有来源主题与新题本，不复现他站题目、隐藏类型或十五维输出。

question.en: Can I get more than one leading theme?
question.zh: 可以出现多个并列主题吗？

answer.en: Yes. Every theme at the largest raw count remains visible. The game makes no random selection among them. All-A or all-B answers produce a valid tie across all twenty-five themes.
answer.zh: 可以。原始次数最大的所有主题都保留，不随机挑一个。全A或全B会出现二十五主题同时并列，也是允许结果。

question.en: What does a count of zero mean?

answer.en: You did not choose that theme’s four descriptions against their particular alternatives. It does not prove that the theme never describes you, that you lack an ability or that another person has more of a trait.
answer.zh: 表示本主题四条描述面对各自对象时，都没有选中。不证明它从不适合你、不具备某能力或别人某种特质更多。

question.en: Are the twenty-five themes personality types?
question.zh: 二十五主题是人格类型吗？

answer.en: They are editorial entertainment themes with complete explanatory guides. This edition does not establish stable types, psychometric scores, mental health states or a full ranking of traits.
answer.zh: 它们是附完整说明的编辑娱乐主题。本版不确定稳定类型、心理测量分数、健康状态或特质完整排名。

question.en: Can I read all the results without answering?
question.zh: 不作答能读全部结果说明吗？

answer.en: Yes. All twenty-five complete guides are public and free. You can read them before starting, after exiting or without ever providing responses.
answer.zh: 可以。二十五篇完整指南公开免费，开始前、退出后或完全不提供回答，都能直接读。

question.en: Does this predict MBTI or another assessment?
question.zh: 能推断MBTI或其他测评结果吗？

answer.en: No. These choices do not determine another assessment. An optional link after the result leads to a separate MBTI assessment with its own purpose and question burden; your answers are not transferred.
answer.zh: 不能。这些选择不决定其他测评。结果后可选链接通向独立MBTI测评，会说明其目的与题量；本页回答不传过去。

question.en: Will my answers survive a reload or language change?
question.zh: 刷新或换语会保留回答吗？

answer.en: No. There is no saved draft or account result. Leaving, refreshing, changing language, clearing and retaking remove the current answers. Public explanation links contain no personal result.
answer.zh: 不会。不保存草稿或账户结果。离开、刷新、换语、清除与重测会移除本次回答；公开解释链接不含个人结果。

answer.en: Yes. The period, interpretation and choices can change. This edition has no meaningful-change threshold, and neither a change nor a repeated result establishes a stable personality or improvement.
answer.zh: 可以。参考时期、理解和选择都可能变化。本版没有有意义变化阈值；变化或重复都不能证明固定人格或改善。
